remainingGaps.description: Exact April 2024 BUA binary, filename, byte length and SHA-256 are unavailable. Hybrid v1 treats this as a non-blocking real-evidence limitation and uses explicit authored completion.
No reproducible official archive for an exact 2024 OS Open Names release was obtained. Hybrid v1 does not represent authored names as OS evidence.
Written permission would be required for SDL geometry bundling and redistributed derived overlays. Hybrid v1 excludes the geometry and records reviewed/authored relations honestly.
Full-resolution overlays remain future enrichment. Hybrid v1 uses official Scottish lookup relations and explicitly reviewed or authored relations elsewhere.
